content: Vikram Singh (insurance agent) confirmed the addition of Kiara Sen's laptop to her home policy's personal property coverage ($150,000 total limit with a $5,000 electronics sub-limit) and sent the revised policy. Kiara then provided the purchase receipt for her smartwatch. Vikram confirmed receipt of the smartwatch document, noting it is now covered up to $2,000, leaving the home policy fully active with all updates.
